name: ActiveCampaign
label: ActiveCampaign — CRM + email automation (REST v3)
description: Official ActiveCampaign REST API v3 (/api/3). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Header Api-Token. Account API host from Settings → Developer (US typically *.api-us1.com). Contact–organization endpoints are deprecated — use Account–Contact. Customer owns the ActiveCampaign account. api_key is never logged or returned. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: contact
schema.description: v3 contact envelope escape hatch for contact.create/update. Purpose fields email/firstName/lastName/phone merge into contact via bodyMap. Custom fieldValues stay here. Example: {"fieldValues":[{"field":1,"value":"x"}]}.

schema.label: contactId
schema.description: Contact id for get/update/delete and nested as contactList.contact on contactList.add/remove. Example: 123.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Contact email for contact.create/update (nested as contact.email; required on create) and contact.list filter. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: firstName
schema.description: Contact first name on contact.create/update. Nested as contact.firstName. Example: Ada.

schema.label: lastName
schema.description: Contact last name on contact.create/update. Nested as contact.lastName. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Contact phone on contact.create/update. Nested as contact.phone. Example: +12025550100.

schema.label: list
schema.description: List id on contactList.add/remove. Nested as contactList.list. Example: 2.

schema.label: status
schema.description: List subscription status on contactList.add/remove. Nested as contactList.status. EXACT: 1 subscribe | 2 unsubscribe. Example: 1.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Account name on account.create/update. Nested as account.name. Example: Acme.

schema.label: listid
schema.description: List id query filter for contact.list. Example: 2.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Per-operation field `limit`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Per-operation field `offset`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: contactList
schema.description: {contact, list, status} escape hatch for contactList.add/remove. Purpose fields contactId/list/status merge in via bodyMap. status EXACT: 1 subscribe | 2 unsubscribe.

schema.label: contactTag
schema.description: {contact, tag} integer ids.

schema.label: contactTagId
schema.description: Per-operation field `contactTagId`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: account
schema.description: v3 account envelope escape hatch for account.create/update. Purpose field name merges as account.name. Example: {"accountUrl":"https://acme.com"}.

schema.label: accountId
schema.description: Per-operation field `accountId`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: search
schema.description: Per-operation field `search`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: accountContact
schema.description: Per-operation field `accountContact`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: accountContactId
schema.description: Per-operation field `accountContactId`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: deal
schema.description: Per-operation field `deal`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: dealId
schema.description: Per-operation field `dealId`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: note
schema.description: Per-operation field `note`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: noteId
schema.description: Per-operation field `noteId`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: tag
schema.description: Per-operation field `tag`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: tagId
schema.description: Per-operation field `tagId`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: ecomOrder
schema.description: Deep Data order (connectionid, email, externalid, totalPrice, currency, orderProducts).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Per-operation field `id`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: ecomCustomer
schema.description: Per-operation field `ecomCustomer`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: connection
schema.description: Per-operation field `connection`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | contactList.add | contactList.remove | contactTag.add | contactTag.remove | account.create | account.get | account.list | account.update | account.delete | accountContact.create | accountContact.update | accountContact.delete | deal.create | deal.get | deal.list | deal.update | deal.delete | deal.note.create | deal.note.update | list.list | tag.create | tag.get | tag.list | tag.update | tag.delete | ecommerce.order.create | ecommerce.order.get | ecommerce.order.list | ecommerce.order.update | ecommerce.order.delete | ecommerce.customer.create | ecommerce.customer.get | ecommerce.customer.list | ecommerce.customer.update | ecommerce.customer.delete | ecommerce.orderProduct.get | ecommerce.orderProduct.list | connection.create | connection.get | connection.list | connection.update | connection.delete | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: API URL host
configurationParameters.description: Host only from Settings → Developer, no scheme (example: acme.api-us1.com). US accounts use *.api-us1.com; EU and other DCs show a different host on that tab. Interpolated as https://{api_url}/api/3/…

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Per-user API key from Settings → Developer. Header Api-Token. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
